session_title: Official Opening Address by YBhg. Datuk Fabian Bigar
session_description: Malaysia’s AI Future: From National Digital Ambition to Real-World Impact

session_speakers.name: Fabian Bigar
session_speakers.about: YBhg. Datuk Fabian Bigar is the Secretary General of Malaysia’s Ministry of Digital and a senior public-sector leader with extensive experience in national policy, economic transformation and digitalisation. A Sarawakian from Kuching, he holds a BSc in Biology from Case Western Reserve University and a Master of Public Policy from GRIPS, Japan. His career spans the Ministry of Health, PEMANDU and the Prime Minister’s Department. He later led MyDIGITAL Corporation and Malaysia’s Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution, driving the Digital Economy Blueprint, 4IR agenda and national digital transformation.

session_title: Blaize Edge AI: Intelligence Everywhere
session_description:
The smartest models in the world still stall out when the answer is needed in milliseconds, on a device with no reliable connection, running on limited power. Blaize was built to close that gap, not with more cloud, but with silicon and software designed to put real inference directly into cameras, machines, vehicles, and infrastructure.

As we enter the new era of Edge Intelligence, hybrid compute, real-time inference, and purpose-built silicon work together to sense, respond, and act instantly. Discover how you can solve your real-world business problems with AI-powered solutions.

session_speakers.name: Eric Liew
session_speakers.about: Eric Liew is a technology business leader with over 25 years of experience spanning enterprise technology, sales, and business development. Currently with Blaize, he focuses on bringing high-performance Edge AI to real-world applications, helping organizations deploy intelligent systems where decisions need to happen in real time, at the edge.

session_speakers.name: Murugason R Thangaratnam
session_speakers.about: Murugason R. Thangaratnam is a cybersecurity and digital trust leader with extensive expertise in cyber resilience, AI governance, and emerging technology risks. He serves as Cyber Defence and Intelligence Lead at Equanimity Group, Adjunct Professor of Practice at UNIMY, and Digital Expert Panel member at MDEC, while contributing to Malaysia’s Ministry of Digital data governance initiatives.

session_title: Breaking Silos: Keeping Humans in Control at AI Speed
session_description: AI is accelerating how organisations build, operate and attack software. But as code, cloud, identities, data and AI workflows change continuously, security teams are often forced to make high-impact decisions with fragmented context. In this keynote, Matt Moore explores why “security without context doesn’t scale,” using a real AI software supply-chain incident to show how modern risk crosses development and production boundaries. He outlines a pragmatic approach to connecting observability and security telemetry so teams can prioritise what matters, govern AI in motion, respond faster and keep consequential decisions firmly under human control.

session_speakers.name: Matt Moore
session_speakers.about: Matt Moore is a passionate speaker, data enthusiast and Principal Observability Strategist at Datadog, helping organisations make technology simpler, safer and easier to operate. With more than 20 years in tech, he brings practical insight, curiosity and humour to the stage. Away from keyboards, he’s an avid pilot and sailor.

session_title: Investing in Execution: How Capital Decides What Survives
session_description: AI is attracting unprecedented capital, but the market has quietly changed what it pays for. Drawing on recent acquisitions, live deployments and second-year deployment economics, Sahaj Kothari sets out the gates an investor applies before committing capital, and why they are the same questions an enterprise should ask before signing a contract. For anyone buying AI, a checklist. For anyone building it, a blueprint.

session_speakers.name: Sahaj Kothari
session_speakers.about: Sahaj Kothari is Partner at Capzara Capital, an operator fund investing in AI and enterprise technology across Europe, the Middle East and Asia. Alongside the fund he runs an operating arm deploying conversational and voice AI into live enterprise environments in telecom, BPO and hospitality. A two-times exited founder who has managed over $100M in revenue across 42 brands, formerly at EY and Bain, with an Oxford first-class Masters. He is an award-winning author and was UK runner-up for Entrepreneur of the Year. He judged the Digihealth pitch finals at GITEX Global Dubai. He does not describe the AI market from a spreadsheet. He sees what actually ships.
